module_summary: Low-level pieces of the in-game EE core (eecore target, ps2.yaml:604-613, linked at 0x84000 by ee_core/linkfile). asm.S holds the syscall hooks (SifSetDma IOP-reboot trap, SifSetReg, ExecPS2, CreateThread, Exit) that switch to the ee_core stack at _end, plus the register-clearing ExecPS2 entry; crt0.S is the trimmed start-up that clears .bss only on the first run. cheat_engine.S/cheat_api.c are the PS2RD cheat engine (SetupThread hook, code handler, in-game-menu live code sets) and the .img cheat-image applier. gsm_api.c/dve_reg.S drive the GSM video-mode forcer (SetGsCrt hook, debug-exception GS write trap, DVE setup for 576p). cd_igr_rpc.c sends OPL's IGR shutdown RPC to CDVDFSV. freeze_diag*.c are the INGAMEDIAG-only freeze report: thread/IOP-heap snapshot, a TV page drawn through GIF PATH3, an RPC with deadlines, and a text formatter shared with the freezediag.irx IOP module.

reusable_helpers.name: oplIGRShutdown
reusable_helpers.what: binds the 0x80000598 IGR RPC server and sends the shutdown/power-off request

reusable_helpers.name: put_dec / put_hex / put_str
reusable_helpers.what: bounded decimal/hex/string append into a fixed text buffer without printf

reusable_helpers.name: ln_dec / ln_hex
reusable_helpers.what: the same bounded decimal/hex append for one screen line (second copy of the formatter helpers)

reusable_helpers.name: budget_spent / ee_ticks
reusable_helpers.what: COP0 Count based millisecond deadline check (wrap-safe)

reusable_helpers.name: fds_wait_ms / fds_ticks
reusable_helpers.what: COP0 Count busy-wait delay in milliseconds (second COP0 Count reader)

reusable_helpers.name: InitRegsExecPS2 / CleanExecPS2
reusable_helpers.what: clears all GPR/FPU/HI/LO/SA registers and resets SP before ExecPS2

findings.title: LinkImage applies the PS2RD .img cheat image before the game is loaded, so the patches never land
findings.problem: LinkImage is called from eecoreInit (main.c:116-117), i.e. on the first ee_core run, before LoadExecPS2 (main.c:181) restarts ee_core, which then wipes user memory (syshook.c:117, plus the kernel wipe from ModStorageEnd) and loads the game ELF (syshook.c:126). At LinkImage time the game is not in memory: the sanity gate reads OPL's leftover memory at Offset0 and fails, and any word it did write is wiped and overwritten by the game load. The $EnableImage option therefore never patches a game.
findings.fix: Delete the .img feature (LinkImage, config->gImage, LoadImage/GetImage/gImage, sbLoadImage and its call sites, the $EnableImage row and strings). If the owner wants to keep it, the apply has to move to sysLoadElf after LoadElf/apply_patches, with the words kept somewhere the wipe does not reach (ee_core has no room for the 4 KB, cheat_api.c:36-38).
findings.benefit: Removes an option that silently does nothing; ~100 lines across ee_core and the menu (INFERRED from the cited ranges plus prototypes/UI rows) and 4 KB of main-ELF .bss (static u32 gImage[MAX_IMAGEWORDS=1024] = 4096 bytes, INFERRED arithmetic).
findings.evidence: Read main.c:40-185 (eecoreInit calls EnableCheats/LinkImage, then main() calls LoadExecPS2; isInit path calls sysLoadElf), syshook.c:86-147 (WipeUserMemory(&_end, ModStorageStart), LoadElf, apply_patches, CleanExecPS2), system.cpp:1195 (kernel InitializeUserMemory set to ModStorageEnd), host.cpp:161-163 (gImage handed over), cheatman.cpp:111-125 (LoadImage), supportbase.cpp:1701-1718. git show 97421c9520: the call was added at eecoreInit with no in-game test noted. grep LinkImage/gImage over tests and .github: no test. INFERRED part: that .img targets are game addresses (format not documented in the repo); any target above 0x97000 is wiped or reloaded.

findings.title: oplIGRShutdown writes poff uncached with SIF_RPC_M_NOWBDC and no cache flush
findings.problem: poffData is a 64-byte-aligned stack slot; its cache line can still be dirty in the write-back D-cache from earlier IGR-thread calls. The value is stored through UNCACHED_SEG and the call uses SIF_RPC_M_NOWBDC, so nothing writes back or invalidates that line; if it is evicted before the SIF DMA reads memory, the stale stack word replaces poff. CDVDMAN then powers the console off (poff != 0, cdvdman.c:289-295) on a normal IGR exit, or skips the power-off on the L3+R3 path (padhook.c:565,669). freeze_diag.c:185 and :214 call FlushCache(0) before the same kind of store for this reason.
findings.fix: Store poff with a normal write and drop SIF_RPC_M_NOWBDC so SifCallRpc writes the send buffer back itself (no extra code); or call FlushCache(0) before the uncached store as freeze_diag.c does.
findings.benefit: Removes a rare wrong-poff case on every IGR exit (unwanted power-off or missed power-off); no size change (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Read cd_igr_rpc.c:1-26; callers padhook.c:565 (oplIGRShutdown(0)) and :669 (oplIGRShutdown(1)), freeze_diag.c:235. IOP side cdvdfsv.c:225-250 reads *(int *)buf as poff, cdvdman.c:279-299 powers off when non-zero. grep SIF_RPC_M_NOWBDC over *.c/*.cpp/*.h: freeze_diag.c:187 and :216 (both preceded by FlushCache(0) at :185/:214) and cd_igr_rpc.c:22 (no flush). INFERRED: the eviction timing between the store and the DMA was not observed on hardware.

findings.title: freeze_diag.c shutdown_cd copies only .server, so the shutdown argument is DMAed to IOP address 0
findings.problem: shutdown_with_deadline fills the second client with shutdown_cd.server = igr_cd.server only. ps2sdk SifCallRpc sends the argument to cd->buf (the server buffer address that SifBindRpc stores in the client), which stays NULL here, so the 4-byte argument goes to IOP address 0 and cbrpc_shutdown (cdvdfsv.c:244) reads whatever its buffer last held. It works today only because the preceding FREEZE_DIAG_RPC_FNO call left 0 in that buffer; the IOP is rebooted right after.
findings.fix: Copy the whole bound client (shutdown_cd = igr_cd) instead of only the server pointer, so buf and cbuf come along.
findings.benefit: The shutdown argument reaches the server and no stray SIF write lands at IOP address 0; INGAMEDIAG builds only; no size change (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Read freeze_diag.c:156-246 (igr_cd bound at :164, shutdown_cd never bound, only .server copied at :213, call at :216 with &shutdown_arg). cdvdfsv.c:173 registers shutdown_rpcbuf for 0x80000598; :232-238 the fno 2 path returns without touching buf; :241-248 fno 1 reads *(int *)buf. INFERRED: ps2sdk SifCallRpc passes cd->buf as the send destination (SDK source is not in the repo). Built only in the ingamediag configuration (tools/build_configuration.py:57-78).
